:::{#sol-cv-estimate-by-fold-simplify}

For $\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}$, @eq-fold-assignment also puts $\iobs$ in $\fold{\foldof{\iobs}}$,
and the folds are disjoint,
so $\foldof{\iobs} = \ifold$.
Then

$$
\ba
\cvest{\nfolds}
&= \frac{1}{\nobs} \sumto{\ifold}{\nfolds} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}
&& \text{(group by fold)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{\nobs} \sumto{\ifold}{\nfolds} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\ifold}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}
&& (\foldof{\iobs} = \ifold \text{ for } \iobs \in \fold{\ifold})
\ea
$$

In the last line, the [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fittedwo{\ifold}{\cdot}$ depends only on the outer index,
so each inner sum uses a single fitted model.

:::
